date.as_written: dahanamunipurāṇaiḥ sammite vikramābde dinakṛti mithunasthe kṛṣṇapakṣadvitithyoḥ ditija ripupurodhasyahni [...] gajāgnyadricandrair mmite śrīśakebde śucau kṛṣṇapakṣe tithāv abjajeśe amarācāryyavāre

notes: The scribe's name is spelled both Jabbarasiṃha (verse 1) and Javarasiṃha (verse 2). The date is given twice in chronograms: VS 1873 (dahana-muni-purāṇa) and Śaka 1738 (gaja-agni-adri-candra), both corresponding to 1816 CE.
